Pauli-character Fourier inversion restricted to anti-L affine coset proves the global iff, and orthogonality gives mean-square defect 8s^4 sum(a b)^2, including omega=0 and sine-zero boundaries. Existence of a third transverse mutually anticommuting term alongside an L-paired pair is excluded by commutation parity. Direct expm-based independent matrix checks in 106 parameter/dimension configurations passed; these are corroborative, not proof.
